text:
I can't finish this without you. Setup needs root, and I can't enter your sudo password. I can install the binary now, then you run setup in your own terminal once you have a Codeberg token.

**Before I run anything, I need answers to these:**

1. **Is `me/notes` public or private?** Tentmaker refuses public repos unless you pass `--allow-public`, because that lets outside contributors' code run on this Mac. I'd recommend keeping it private unless you specifically need outside PRs to run here.
2. **Is it OK to put a Codeberg token on this Mac?** That makes this Mac a broker: the token is stored in the macOS Keychain, and only this device holds it. Use a token scoped to repository read and commit status write, and nothing else.
3. **Is Tailscale installed on this Mac?** If not, I'll add `--no-mesh`, which works fine for a single device.
4. **Are the default budgets fine?** The defaults are a quarter of RAM for everyday use and half for boost (plugged in). Tell me if you want different numbers.

**Step 1: check for an existing install (no root needed)**

```sh
command -v tentmaker && tentmaker version --json
```

I expect "not found", since Tentmaker isn't installed.

**Step 2: install the binary (no root needed)**

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/baney75/tentmaker/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-setup
tentmaker version --json
```

Without root, this installs to `~/.local/bin`. If the installer says that directory isn't on your PATH, I'll use the full path it prints.

**Step 3: create a Codeberg token (you do this in the browser)**

Go to Codeberg → Settings → Applications → Generate New Token. Give it repository read and commit status write, and copy it. Don't paste it into this chat.

**Step 4: run setup in your own terminal**

Once you've decided the questions above, run this yourself. It will ask for your sudo password, and then it will read the token from the keyboard:

```sh
sudo tentmaker setup --yes --json --repo me/notes --forge forgejo --forge-url https://codeberg.org --mode checks --token-stdin
```

Paste the token, press Enter, then press Ctrl-D. Add `--no-mesh` if Tailscale isn't installed. Add `--allow-public` only if you chose to allow it in question 1.

Codeberg runs Forgejo, so `--forge forgejo` is the right choice. Tentmaker runs this repo in checks mode and posts commit statuses named `tentmaker/<job name>`.

**Step 5: verify**

```sh
tentmaker doctor --json
tentmaker repo list --json
```

Setup is done when `doctor` exits 0 and `repo list` shows `me/notes`.

**Step 6: point the workflows at the pool (later, with your yes)**

Checks mode doesn't need changes to your workflow files. I won't commit or push anything without your go-ahead.

Send me your answers to the four questions, and tell me when you have the token. I'll run steps 1 and 2 right after.
